steps.title: From words to motion in three steps

1.title: Write a prompt
1.body: Describe the subject, the light and the mood. Plain words work.

2.title: Pick the best image
2.body: Make a few and keep the one that fits. A failed image gives its credit back.

1.title: What can I make?

RapLanding.title: AI Rap Video Generator from Photos
RapLanding.metaTitle: AI Rap Video Generator: Two Photos to a Rap Video
RapLanding.description: Turn two photos and two names into a 15-second rap video. vibemovo writes the lyrics and makes the beat, the vocals and the lip sync.

hero.title: AI rap video generator from photos
hero.body: Upload two photos and type two names. You get a 15-second video of both people rapping, with lines written for their names, a beat and vocals.

result.video: A real 15-second AI rap video: a woman in a green suit and a man in a blue suit rap in an orange studio with a hanging microphone.
result.caption: A real result, made from two photos of AI-generated people. Turn on the sound to hear the rap.

steps.title: From two photos to one rap video

1.title: Upload two photos
1.body: One person in each photo, facing the camera, in good light. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {size} MB each.

2.title: Type two names
2.body: Up to {max} characters each. Each person gets one line, written for their name.

3.title: Generate
3.body: One video costs {credits} credits. It is usually ready in a few minutes, and you can play or download it.

1.title: Lyrics for their names
1.body: The two lines rhyme and use the two names. They are in the language of the page: English or Chinese.

2.title: Beat and vocals included
2.body: You don't upload a song. The video comes with its own beat, both voices and lip movement.

3.title: Same faces, same sides
3.body: Each face and outfit stays the same for the whole clip. The left photo stays on the left.

birthday.body: Put the birthday person and a friend in the booth. Each one raps a line with their own name in it.

couple.title: Couples and anniversaries

team.title: Team goodbyes
team.body: Send off a coworker with a rap that names them and the teammate who made it.

friends.title: Best friends and siblings
friends.body: Swap the photos to swap the order: the left photo always raps first.

tips.title: Photos that work
tips.guide: Read the full guide with a real test run

1.title: One person per photo.
1.body: Two faces in one photo can end up mixed.

2.title: Face the camera, in good light.
2.body: The model copies the face it can see. Sunglasses stay on.

3.title: Show more of the body if you can.
3.body: A full-body photo keeps the real outfit. A portrait leaves the rest to the model.

4.title: Use photos you may use.
4.body: Only animate people who agreed to it.

1.title: How much does a rap video cost?
1.body: {credits} credits for one 15-second video. New accounts get {signup} free credits, enough for your first rap video. Buy credits on the <pricing>pricing page</pricing>.

2.title: What if a video fails?
2.body: You get the credits back. Try again with the same photos or different ones.

3.title: How long does it take?
3.body: Usually a few minutes. You can close the page: you get a notification when the video is ready.

4.title: Which languages are the lyrics in?
4.body: The language of the page: English on the English site, Chinese on the Chinese site.

5.title: Is the song original?
5.body: Yes. The page writes new lines from the two names and creates its own beat and vocals, so the clip uses no one else's song. Clips that copy a real track can be muted or taken down.

6.title: Can I choose the song or the lines?
6.body: Not yet. The page writes the lines, and the model makes the beat.

7.title: What format is the video?
7.body: A 16:9 MP4, 1280×720, 15 seconds, with sound. For TikTok or Reels, crop it to 9:16.

8.title: Whose photos can I use?
8.body: Your own, or photos of people who agreed to be in the video. See the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.

HugLanding.title: Hug Your Younger Self AI Video Generator

result.video: A real 15-second AI younger-self hug video: a man in a blue suit kneels beside a boy in a sunny park and hugs him.
result.caption: A real result and four of its frames, made from two photos of an AI-generated person. The hug starts at about 8 seconds, and the light comes at about 12.

VampireLanding.title: AI Vampire Transformation Video Generator
VampireLanding.metaTitle: AI Vampire Transformation: One Photo to Video
VampireLanding.description: Turn one photo into a 10-second vampire transformation: lightning strikes in a candlelit castle and you get pale skin, red eyes, fangs and a cape.

hero.title: AI vampire transformation video from one photo
hero.body: Upload one photo. You get a 10-second vertical Halloween video: lightning strikes in a candlelit castle and you turn into a vampire, with red eyes, small fangs and a crimson-lined cape.

result.alt: Four frames from a 10-second AI vampire transformation video: a man in a blue blazer in a candlelit castle hall, lightning strikes and he wears a crimson-lined cape with red eyes, a close-up of his fangs, then bats fly around him.
result.video: A real 10-second AI vampire transformation video: a man in a candlelit castle hall turns into a vampire with red eyes and fangs.
result.caption: A real result and four of its frames, made from one photo of an AI-generated person. The change starts with the lightning at about 3 seconds; the fangs show at about 6.

steps.title: From one photo to one vampire

1.title: Upload your photo
1.body: One person, facing the camera, in good light. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {size} MB.

2.title: Generate

3.title: Play or download
3.body: It is usually ready in a few minutes. You get a notification if you leave the page.

1.title: The whole change in 10 seconds

3.title: Still your face

ApiKeys.docsBody: Send the key in the x-api-key header. Only the image and video routes accept it. Submit a job, ask about it until its status isn’t pending, then download the result.
